tasks.short: Analyze sites for RFID configurations and implementation obstacles.

steps.what: Retrieve site layouts and current equipment configuration references
Perform site analyses of RF obstacles, material flows and configuration locations through physical survey and operator discussion
outputs: captured site measurements, photographs and process observations

steps.what: Determine system configurations, processes impacted and on-site obstacles from the actual survey
inputs: captured site measurements, photographs and process observations

steps.what: Prepare the site analysis report with native insertion of captured locations and photographs
inputs: captured site measurements, photographs and process observations

steps.what: Approve the final report and its internal project record destination
Commit the approved site analysis to the internal project record

tasks.design: Configure site reference links and photo/location report fields in {OTHER}, the RFID survey and RF measurement tool, and {DOCS}. The specialist still visits, measures, discusses and interprets. Reuse captured evidence when preparing the report, then commit only its exact approved version. Changes void approval. This survey covers physical layout and RF/process obstacles; the separate IT inventory task covers hardware/software inventory rather than repeating this survey.
tasks.previous_blocker: Survey evidence is recopied into a report after the site visit.
tasks.enabler_now: Native location-linked capture and report fields can reuse actual evidence without generating conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Real RF obstacles and process changes require site judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize nonrepresentative observations and implementation hazards.

ambition.what: Make site evidence easier to trace.

tasks.altitude: A survey documentation aid around retained site analysis.

reach.learn: Use the recorded obstacle locations and unresolved conditions.

evidence.claim: Survey tools and document templates can reuse captured locations, images and reference fields.

assumptions: s2 counts actual new capture. Existing layouts may be incomplete; validation and correction remain in s2.
No external report send is proposed.
unknowns: Whether native survey reports already avoid recopying.
research_questions: Which evidence fields are entered twice today?

already_counted.description: Site capture and final report review remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: approved site analysis version with project destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Five lookup, three report assembly and two filing hours saved, less one upkeep hour. Existing native configuration may leave no additional saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine how RFID integrates into other applications.

steps.what: Inspect target application APIs, event schemas and RFID middleware connector documentation
Determine means of integrating RFID into other applications, including event ownership, identifier mapping and failure handling
Document the integration method with selected schema references and manually authored sequence and exception diagrams
Review the final integration method and approve its internal architecture record version
Commit the approved integration method to the internal architecture record

tasks.design: Use version filters and connector documentation in {OTHER}, the application integration and RFID middleware engineering tools, with linked interface tables in {DOCS}. Existing native connectors are evaluated first. The specialist checks compatibility and determines architecture; native schema-reference insertion reduces copying when writing the method. A separate approved action files the completed document. Changed methods return to review. No live application configuration or deployment is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interface capabilities must be compared across application and middleware documentation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native versioned API references and schema reuse can reduce reference assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting event ownership, recovery behavior and acceptable coupling.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the application's operational consequences rather than equate API availability with a sound integration.
tasks.altitude: Interface evidence assistance around human architecture selection.

reach.learn: Check explicit recovery and identifier mappings.

evidence.claim: Middleware documentation and schema tools support versioned connector references and reusable interface descriptions.

assumptions: s1 includes manually checking documentation gaps. Application-owner clarification is counted in s2, with no new prepared input required from them.
Implementation belongs to separate integration work; no implementation time saving is claimed here.
research_questions: Can an existing supported connector meet the method before custom code?

already_counted.description: Interface verification and final architecture review.

approvals.approved_version: approved integration method version and architecture record target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Ten interface lookup, five documentation and five filing hours saved, less one upkeep hour. Low case has the same native functionality already in use.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide technical support for RFID technology.

steps.what: Clarify the RFID support problem and capture actual reader, tag, middleware and symptom details
Retrieve relevant reader diagnostics, firmware-specific manuals and previous matching support cases
Provide technical support for RFID technology through diagnosis, safe user guidance and confirmation of observed behavior
outputs: diagnosis, guidance and unresolved issue state

steps.what: Prepare the customer response and internal case note using selected approved instructions and the specialist's diagnosis
inputs: diagnosis, guidance and unresolved issue state
outputs: final proposed response and case note with recipient

steps.what: Approve the complete support response, case status and customer recipient
inputs: final proposed response and case note with recipient

steps.what: Send the approved support response to the named customer
Commit the approved support note and actual unresolved or resolved status to the internal case

tasks.design: Configure equipment and firmware filters across {HELPDESK}, {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the reader diagnostic and RFID middleware tools. The specialist captures context, diagnoses and explains guidance. Native snippets and source links assist the written response and case note. After the entire package exists, a human approves exact content, status and recipient. Separate native actions send externally and commit internally. Edits invalidate approval. No remote device reconfiguration is proposed; such intervention requires its own later reviewed configuration and action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated manual lookup and retyping around customer-specific troubleshooting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case metadata, controlled snippets and diagnostic links can reduce support administration.
tasks.still_hard: The same missing-read symptom can have physical, network or application causes.
tasks.human_edge: Probe actual conditions and avoid claiming resolution without evidence.

ambition.what: Support current customers with more traceable guidance.

tasks.altitude: A diagnostic reference and response aid.

reach.learn: Receive actual unresolved symptoms instead of an inferred resolution.

evidence.claim: Support systems can filter equipment cases, insert approved response snippets and route reviewed responses.

assumptions: s1 and s3 count user dialogue and manual symptom capture. s2 includes manual diagnostic gaps; no clean logs are assumed.
Customer actions remain theirs; the proposed tool does not change their equipment.
research_questions: Which support lookups and snippets reduce effort after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Capture context and approve actual response and status.

incremental.description: Retire outdated diagnostic links and snippets.

approvals.approved_version: approved support package version including final response and customer recipient
approved support package version including case note, actual status and case target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Ten lookup, 4.5 drafting and five send/record hours saved, less one upkeep hour. Existing native support configuration may yield no incremental saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect client systems and process data for RFID implementation.

steps.what: Agree authorized read access and identify client hardware, software, network and business-process evidence sources
Collect data about existing client hardware, software and networking from authorized native inventory and configuration exports
inputs: existing client inventory and configuration records
outputs: collected native exports with timestamps and gaps

steps.what: Interview process owners and inspect missing client system details, capturing actual key business processes and exceptions
inputs: collected native exports with timestamps and gaps
outputs: captured business processes and manually verified inventory gaps

steps.what: Normalize source inventory fields and associate captured process notes with the affected systems
inputs: collected native exports with timestamps and gaps
captured business processes and manually verified inventory gaps
outputs: proposed client systems and process dataset with provenance

steps.what: Verify the collected dataset against actual sources and approve the final internal implementation evidence version
inputs: proposed client systems and process dataset with provenance

steps.what: Commit the approved dataset to the restricted internal RFID implementation record

tasks.design: Use native authorized exports from {OTHER}, the client IT asset and network configuration inventory, and {OPS_SYSTEM}. Configure deterministic import mappings in {SPREADSHEET}; unknown values stay unknown. The specialist still requests access, interviews owners and records processes and missing details, then verifies provenance. Separately commit the approved dataset to restricted {DOCS}. Source or access changes void approval. Collection is read-only and introduces no network scans or client-system writes. Physical RF obstacle analysis belongs to the separate site-analysis task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Client inventory fields are retyped and reconciled with unstructured process descriptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing export functions and explicit field mappings reduce repeated collection and normalization.
tasks.still_hard: Undocumented interfaces and workarounds are absent from inventory exports.
tasks.human_edge: Find actual business processes and challenge stale asset records.

ambition.what: Collect the same implementation evidence more consistently.

tasks.altitude: Read-only inventory import with retained human discovery.

reach.learn: Reuse existing authorized exports without preparing a new survey spreadsheet.

evidence.claim: IT inventories and operational systems often offer native exports that can be mapped deterministically into a collection register.

assumptions: Existing administrators maintain inventories in ordinary work. s2 counts specialist export setup and gaps; s3 counts all new manual inventory and process capture.
No client is asked to prepare new structured inputs; any necessary access dialogue is in s1.
research_questions: Which fields need onsite verification despite an export?

already_counted.description: Manual process capture and final evidence verification.

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and remove obsolete retained client exports.

approvals.approved_version: approved client evidence dataset with restricted internal record target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Fifteen collection, eight normalization and two record-entry hours saved, less two upkeep hours. Low case assumes existing export and import configuration already covers the opportunity.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: RFID site and systems discovery supported by traceable native records.
reach: Client IT, operations and application architects share evidence without repeated input preparation.
role.ambitious_version: Use reliable evidence to make better RFID integration decisions while retaining site and customer judgement.
